name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
description: A volatile flask designed to ignite a struck target until extinguished.
narrative_effects: Supports ignition and ongoing burning pressure until put out.

mechanical_effect.trigger: flask strikes or is applied to a target that can ignite or suffer ongoing burning pressure
mechanical_effect.modifier: ignition plus ongoing burning pressure until put out
mechanical_effect.applies_to: checks to ignite targets, create fire hazards, force a target to deal with burning, or maintain pressure through alchemical fire
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: nonflammable or fireproof targets; underwater or smothered conditions; situations where ongoing flame cannot persist
